description: Complete approve-placement endpoint stub in governance.py with full security gates: candidate hash verification, manifest hash verification, manifest ID verification, contract hash verification, self-approval prevention, and state enforcement. Extends existing WAVE 4 stub, does not create new route. This feature depends on FEAT-001 (ImplementationApproval model must exist first).
steps: Read existing services/project-ai/app/api/routes/governance.py approve-placement stub (marked with WAVE 4 comment)
Extend WorkflowApprovalPayload Pydantic model to add: candidate_sha256 (str), placement_manifest_id (str)
Update approve_placement() endpoint implementation to create ImplementationApproval record when approval granted
Add candidate_sha256 verification: must match workflow's stored candidate hash (raise 409 CANDIDATE_HASH_MISMATCH if mismatch)
Add placement_manifest_id verification: must match workflow's stored manifest ID (raise 409 MANIFEST_ID_MISMATCH if mismatch)
Keep existing manifest_hash verification (already in stub)
Keep existing contract_hash verification (already in stub)
Keep existing self-approval prevention logic (already in stub, raises 403)
Keep existing state enforcement (workflow must be in AWAITING_IMPLEMENTATION_APPROVAL, already in stub)
Store ImplementationApproval in new _implementation_approvals: Dict[str, ImplementationApproval] in-memory dict
Populate ImplementationApproval.evidence dict with verification results: manifest_hash_verified, contract_hash_verified, candidate_hash_verified, manifest_id_verified, state_verified
Update WorkflowApprovalResponse or create new response model to include candidate_sha256_verified and manifest_id_verified fields
Add GET endpoint: GET /approvals/workflows/{workflow_id}/implementation-approval that returns ImplementationApproval record or 404
Create services/project-ai/tests/test_approval_endpoint.py with httpx.AsyncClient tests (pattern from test_tasks.py)

Test cases: approve with valid data (success), self-approval (403), manifest hash mismatch (409), candidate hash mismatch (409), manifest ID mismatch (409), wrong state (409), GET found, GET not found
All tests must use pytest-asyncio and httpx for async API testing
acceptance_criteria: POST /approvals/workflows/{workflow_id}/approve-placement accepts candidate_sha256 and placement_manifest_id in payload
Endpoint verifies all hashes: manifest_sha256, contract_hash, candidate_sha256
Endpoint verifies manifest ID matches workflow's stored manifest ID
Endpoint creates ImplementationApproval record with status=APPROVED on success
Endpoint raises 403 if approved_by equals workflow requester (self-approval)
Endpoint raises 409 if any hash mismatch detected
Endpoint raises 409 if manifest ID mismatch detected
Endpoint raises 409 if workflow not in AWAITING_IMPLEMENTATION_APPROVAL state
GET /approvals/workflows/{workflow_id}/implementation-approval returns approval record if exists, 404 otherwise
All test cases pass: pytest tests/test_approval_endpoint.py shows 100% pass rate
